The '''Sith&ndash;Imperial attack ship''' was deployed by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[137 ABY]].

==Characteristics==
Each vessel was equipped with an ordnance bay on the ventral hull, from which clusters of bombs could be released. Each had four wings and two laser cannons.

==History==
The Sith Imperial military unit [[Quad Victor|Squadron Quad Victor]] used these ships' bombing capabilities in an [[Devastation of Da Soocha|attack]] on [[Da Soocha]]. They were used to deploy [[Vul Isen]]'s toxins throughout the planet. At about the same time, [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]] captured one of these craft on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and used it to escape the planet to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].
